stemMd: A rectangle has perimeter 46 centimeters and length 5 centimeters greater than its width. What is its area in square centimeters?
explanationMd: Let width be w and length w+5. Then 2w+2(w+5)=46, so 4w=36 and w=9. Length is 14, giving area 9×14=126 square centimeters.
